title: 第15章 冰寒第16章 审判之鳞
lines: 冰冷。
比风雷堡的寒风更刺骨，比亵渎之炉的怨念更深沉，比龙晶的寒意更彻底的冰冷，如同亿万根钢针穿刺着卡拉斯残存的意识。
他感觉自己像被投入深渊的残铁，承受着冰与火的双重折磨。
咸涩的海水灌满口鼻，带着死亡的气息。
肋下那道巨大的伤口在海水浸泡下只剩下麻木的空虚。
每一次心跳都像是最后的挣扎，每一次呼吸都换来更汹涌的海水倒灌。
灵魂链接上，冰冷的束缚感如同沉入深海的铁锚，拖拽着他不断下沉。
链接另一端传来断断续续、微弱如风中残烛的生命脉动。
暗爪…它还在挣扎…在冰冷的海底…
这个念头在卡拉斯即将沉沦的意识中激起一丝微澜。
不能死…不能让它独自沉在黑暗里…
求生的本能如同被这微弱脉动点燃的余烬，爆发出最后的力量。
他用尽残存意志，在冰冷海水中挣扎起来，挥舞沉重的手臂，双腿徒劳地蹬踏。
不是为了浮起，而是逆着那拖拽灵魂链接的沉重感，向着微弱生命脉动的方向挣扎。
咸涩的海水灌入肺腑，带来撕裂般的剧痛和眩晕。
眼前是绝对的黑暗，只有冰冷的海流撕扯着他残破的躯壳。
下沉…依旧在不可阻挡地下沉…灵魂链接传来的脉动微弱得几乎断绝…
就在意识即将熄灭的瞬间——
一股强大而混乱的洋流如同苏醒的巨兽，猛地裹挟住他下沉的身体。
这股洋流带着无法抗拒的力量，卷起冰冷的海沙和破碎的贝类残骸，如同狂暴的漩涡将他狠狠抛掷、翻滚。
天旋地转。
骨头仿佛要散架。
灵魂链接上的微弱脉动瞬间被狂暴乱流冲散。
卡拉斯彻底失去方向，如同狂风中的落叶，被海底的巨力无情玩弄、撕扯。
冰冷和窒息感如同厚重的裹尸布将他包裹…
不知过了多久，也许是一瞬，也许是永恒。
剧烈的咳嗽撕扯着灼痛的喉咙，带着浓重的咸腥味和铁锈味。
冰冷粗糙的触感紧贴着后背和脸颊。
意识如同沉在深海的巨石，被强行拖拽回痛苦的现实。
卡拉斯艰难地睁开沉重的眼皮。
刺目的光线灼痛了久居黑暗的瞳孔。
他下意识地眯起眼，视线模糊，如同隔着一层血污和盐粒凝结的毛玻璃。
首先感受到的是冰冷。
不是海水的湿冷，而是带着咸腥的寒意，如同细小的刀片刮过裸露的皮肤。
然后是痛。
content_en:
Ice cold.
It was more biting than the cold wind of Fenglei Castle, deeper than the resentment of the Blasphemous Furnace, and more completely cold than the chill of dragon crystal, like billions of steel needles piercing Karas' remaining consciousness.
He felt like a piece of broken iron being thrown into the abyss, enduring the dual torment of ice and fire.
The salty seawater filled his mouth and nose, carrying the smell of death.
The huge wound under his ribs was soaked in seawater, leaving only a numb emptiness.
Every heartbeat feels like a final struggle, and every breath brings more turbulent seawater pouring back.
On the soul link, the cold feeling of restraint was like an anchor sinking into the deep sea, dragging him down.
From the other end of the link came the intermittent and weak pulse of life, as weak as a candle in the wind.
Darkclaw...it's still struggling...on the icy bottom...
This thought stirred up a slight ripple in Karas's sinking consciousness.
Can't die...can't let it sink alone in the darkness...
The instinct to survive is like an ember ignited by this weak pulse, bursting out with its final strength.
He exhausted his remaining will and struggled in the cold water, waving his heavy arms and kicking his legs in vain.
Not to float, but to fight against the heaviness that drags the soul link, and to struggle in the direction of the weak pulse of life.
The salty seawater poured into his lungs, causing tearing pain and dizziness.
There was absolute darkness in front of him, with only the cold current tearing at his broken body.
Sinking...still sinking unstoppably...the pulse from the soul link is so weak that it is almost cut off...
At the moment when consciousness is about to extinguish——
A powerful and chaotic ocean current was like an awakening giant beast, suddenly wrapping around his sinking body.
This ocean current carried irresistible force, rolling up the cold sea sand and broken shellfish remains, throwing and rolling him like a violent whirlpool.
The world is spinning.
The bones seemed to be falling apart.
The weak pulse on the soul link was instantly washed away by the violent turbulence.
Karas completely lost his direction, like a fallen leaf in the strong wind, being ruthlessly played with and torn apart by the huge force on the seabed.
The feeling of coldness and suffocation wrapped him like a thick shroud...
I don’t know how long it took, maybe a moment, maybe an eternity.
A violent cough tore at his burning throat, carrying a strong smell of salty fish and rust.
A cold, rough touch pressed against his back and cheeks.
Consciousness is like a boulder sunk in the deep sea, being forcibly dragged back to painful reality.
Karas opened his heavy eyelids with difficulty.
The dazzling light burned the pupils that had been in darkness for a long time.
He subconsciously squinted his eyes, his vision blurry, like frosted glass separated by a layer of blood and salt particles.
The first thing I felt was the coldness.
It's not the dampness of sea water, but the salty chill, like a tiny blade scraping across exposed skin.
Then comes the pain.
title_en: Chapter 15 Ice and Cold Chapter 16 Scales of Judgment
